description: The epistemic origin of a file's values — empirically observed (measured from experimental data) vs. computationally predicted (generated by a model) — factored out of the compound ENCODE output_type / DataType / FeatureType terms. A provenance facet recording how the values were obtained, not what they mean. Absent means unspecified (not a default of observed). `control` is deliberately excluded: it denotes an experimental role or normalization reference, not the measured-vs-model axis.
title: Derivation
